question_asked: Does this tile contain a traffic sign AT ALL? — `G1_RESULT.md:17`'s own subclass 1, `no sign visible in the crop at all: sky, foliage, building walls, clouds`.
charity_note: ⚠️ G1's selection was 'the largest-area sign/LIGHT detection', so some tiles were produced by a `traffic light` box, and the tile alone does not say which. Scored CHARITABLY: `wrong` means NO traffic infrastructure of either kind is visible, not merely 'no sign'. This can only move the number in G1's favour.

verdict_scheme.correct: a traffic sign (or traffic light) is visibly present in the tile
verdict_scheme.wrong: no traffic sign or light in the tile at all — sky, cloud, foliage, wall, facade, plain road, a whole unresolved scene
verdict_scheme.unclear: a sign-shaped or sign-mounted structure may be present but cannot be resolved at this fidelity. ⚠️ NOT a soft `wrong` — reported as its own arm.

escalation_note: Every cell scored `unclear` or borderline on the 320-px contact sheet was RE-RENDERED at 620 px and looked at again (`crops/zoomC_1.png`, `crops/zoomC_2.png`) before its verdict was fixed. #3001 was promoted from `unclear` to `correct` by that step, so the escalation demonstrably works in the detector's favour and is not a formality.
